message.content: {"note_claim": "The video shows the October 8, 2022 explosion on the Kerch Bridge linking Russia to Crimea.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "CCTV footage appears to show the moment the bridge linking Crimea and Russia was hit by a huge explosion early on Saturday morning.", "reason": "The Guardian page presents CCTV video of the Kerch bridge explosion dated 8 Oct 2022, substantiating that such footage exists from that event, though it does not address the Bahrain causeway claim."}

parsed.note_claim: The video shows the October 8, 2022 explosion on the Kerch Bridge linking Russia to Crimea.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: CCTV footage appears to show the moment the bridge linking Crimea and Russia was hit by a huge explosion early on Saturday morning.
parsed.reason: The Guardian page presents CCTV video of the Kerch bridge explosion dated 8 Oct 2022, substantiating that such footage exists from that event, though it does not address the Bahrain causeway claim.
